RP_remainder.integration: physical feedback coefficient (1-exp(-dt/tau))/dt with fixed nominal inertia; no RP integral

yaw_retained.queue_rule: round(delay_s/dt), matching frozen QuadEnv at the selected physical dt

fit_scope: Mean per-run rate MSE divided by max(0.0025,mean(true_rate^2)); same 3 training traces for both models. Each axis independently fits gain[.85,1.15], tau[.001,.15]s, delay[0,.10]s. Native shaper parameters are fixed from actual logs.

forward_model_inputs.prediction: Only controller command time/value history and own simulated shaper/filter internal states. No recorded gyro, attitude, quaternion, ATTITUDE_TARGET, or BIN desired rate enters prediction.
forward_model_inputs.initialization: Shaper target rate starts from first controller command, target acceleration zero; first-order remainder starts gain times first command. No measured state initialization.
forward_model_inputs.training_teacher_use: Recorded BIN gyro enters optimization residuals only. Held-out gyro enters score only. Recorded ATTITUDE_TARGET enters separate descriptive shaper verification only.

validation_limits: Four wind route traces use one fixed policy111 and one environment seed83301 across scenario/interface cases. They are held out from this physical-response fit, not a new independent policy acceptance set.
claims: Nominal physical-response candidate. No randomized-fault validation, policy improvement, Gazebo acceptance, or production readiness claimed.
